overview: 今日共收录72篇文献，覆盖机器学习、计算物理和功能材料方向。
trends: 文献主要涉及结构—性质建模、有限温度/动力学模拟以及材料电子与磁性问题；缺少原文细节的条目不作定量推断。

full_list.title_en: Physics Informed Priors for Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials with Uncertainty Quantification
full_list.title_zh: 具有不确定性量化的机器学习原子间势的物理学先验知识
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.09325v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Standard uncertainty quantification methods for machine learning interatomic potentials often fail to quantify the effects of model misspecification despite its prominence as a source of error. To combat this, misspecification-aware uncertainty schemes have been gaining attention, pointwise optimal parameter set regression (POPS-Regression) among them. However, no guarantees on the physicality of the posterior distribution are given and uncertainty estimates can be conservative compared to the true error. To combat this, we present a model misspecification aware scheme that builds on POPS-Regression by allowing users to specify physical priors that are enforced across the obtained ensemble of models. This allows the user to incorporate misspecification-aware uncertainties without compromising on physical properties. The scheme is applicable to any physical quantity that can be represented by a convex set of parameters and so is robust for a wide variety of static properties which can help inform dynamical simulations. Here, we demonstrate the scheme for phononic vibrations and elastic properties. The scheme is also applied to both linear and message-passing neural network potentials by exploiting the linearity available in both architectures; for neural network potentials we approximate the readout layer as a linear model based on fixed non-linear features. The versatility of the method provides an alternative to hand-crafted or active learning approaches to data-set construction to correct physical failures by adding data thus reducing the computational overhead for designing potentials for specific applications.
full_list.abstract_zh: 机器学习原子间势的标准不确定性量化方法通常无法量化模型错误指定的影响，尽管它是一个突出的错误来源。为了解决这个问题，错误指定的不确定性方案已经引起了人们的关注，其中逐点最优参数集回归（POPS-Regression）就是其中之一。然而，没有给出对后验分布的物理性的保证，并且与真实误差相比，不确定性估计可以是保守的。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种模型错误指定感知方案，该方案基于 POPS 回归，允许用户指定在获得的模型集合中强制执行的物理先验。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 机器学习原子间势的标准不确定性量化方法通常无法量化模型错误指定的影响，尽管它是一个突出的错误来源。为了解决这个问题，错误指定的不确定性方案已经引起了人们的关注，其中逐点最优参数集回归（POPS-Regression）就是其中之一。然而，没有给出对后验分布的物理性的保证，并且与真实误差相比，不确定性估计可以是保守的。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种模型错误指定感知方案，该方案基于 POPS 回归，允许用户指定在获得的模型集合中强制执行的物理先验。这使得用户能够在不影响物理特性的情况下纳入错误指定的不确定性。该方案适用于可以由一组凸参数表示的任何物理量，因此对于各种静态属性都具有鲁棒性，这有助于为动态模拟提供信息。在这里，我们演示了声子振动和弹性特性的方案。该方案还通过利用两种架构中可用的线性度，应用于线性和消息传递神经网络潜力；对于神经网络势，我们将读出层近似为基于固定非线性特征的线性模型。该方法的多功能性为数据集构建提供了一种替代手工或主动学习方法的方法，通过添加数据来纠正物理故障，从而减少为特定应用设计潜力的计算开销。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入非绝热分子动力学、电子—声子耦合、Wannier/GW-BSE 和载流子输运。从摘要能确认的线索包括：神经网络原子间势, 主动学习和高通量采样，以及声子、有限温度和输运性质对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“先用高精度电子结构和声子/电子—声子矩阵元建立小规模基准，再训练可迁移 Hamiltonian 或 ML 势，最后在长时间尺度非绝热 MD、输运或界面电荷转移中验证”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：非绝热分子动力学、电子—声子耦合、Wannier/GW-BSE 和载流子输运已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到卤化物钙钛矿、二维半导体、FeSe、光电界面和能源材料。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注声子、有限温度和输运性质在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的非绝热分子动力学、电子—声子耦合、Wannier/GW-BSE 和载流子输运嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在卤化物钙钛矿、二维半导体、FeSe、光电界面和能源材料中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“先用高精度电子结构和声子/电子—声子矩阵元建立小规模基准，再训练可迁移 Hamiltonian 或 ML 势，最后在长时间尺度非绝热 MD、输运或界面电荷转移中验证”补充训练/验证集，再比较《具有不确定性量化的机器学习原子间势的物理学先验知识》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: A Machine Learning study of the two-dimensional antiferromagnetic Q-state Potts model on the square lattice
full_list.title_zh: 方格上二维反铁磁Q状态Potts模型的机器学习研究
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2512.06762v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The critical phenomena of 2D antiferromagnetic Q-state Potts model on the square lattice with Q=2,3,4,5 and 6 are investigated using supervised neural networks (NN). Conventional supervised and unsupervised NNs either fail or have difficulty in identifying the correct critical behaviors of these models. Remarkably, despite the fact that the NNs employed here are trained with a particular fixed type training set which contains no information about the considered models (except for Q=2), they correctly compute the critical temperatures for the studied physical systems. Particularly, the NN outcomes suggest convincingly that the Q=3 model is critical only at zero temperature and Q=4,5,6 models remain disordered at all temperatures. Apart from the studied models, our NNs trained with exactly the same training set have successfully determined the critical temperature(s) and the nature of the associated phase transition(s) of another physical system differing dramatically from those considered here. Therefore, our NN has the potential to be a universally applicable NN model in studying phase transitions.
full_list.abstract_zh: 利用监督神经网络（NN）研究了 Q=2、3、4、5 和 6 方格上二维反铁磁 Q 态 Potts 模型的临界现象。传统的监督和无监督神经网络要么失败，要么难以识别这些模型的正确关键行为。值得注意的是，尽管这里使用的神经网络是用特定的固定类型训练集进行训练的，该训练集不包含有关所考虑模型的信息（Q = 2 除外），但它们正确地计算了所研究的物理系统的临界温度。特别是，NN 结果令人信服地表明，Q=3 模型仅在零温度下至关重要，而 Q=4,5,6 模型在所有温度下都保持无序。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 利用监督神经网络（NN）研究了 Q=2、3、4、5 和 6 方格上二维反铁磁 Q 态 Potts 模型的临界现象。传统的监督和无监督神经网络要么失败，要么难以识别这些模型的正确关键行为。值得注意的是，尽管这里使用的神经网络是用特定的固定类型训练集进行训练的，该训练集不包含有关所考虑模型的信息（Q = 2 除外），但它们正确地计算了所研究的物理系统的临界温度。特别是，NN 结果令人信服地表明，Q=3 模型仅在零温度下至关重要，而 Q=4,5,6 模型在所有温度下都保持无序。除了研究的模型之外，我们使用完全相同的训练集训练的神经网络已成功确定了另一个物理系统的临界温度和相关相变的性质，该系统与此处考虑的系统显着不同。因此，我们的神经网络有潜力成为研究相变的普遍适用的神经网络模型。

full_list.title_en: Active learning and explicit electrostatics enable accurate modeling of electrolytes
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Active learning and explicit electrostatics enable accurate modeling of electrolytes
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2510.03479v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) combine near-ab initio accuracy with the computational efficiency of classical force fields, making them promising tools for modeling molecular liquids and electrolytes. Their predictive accuracy depends strongly on the diversity of the training set, while the explicit treatment of electrostatics is increasingly recognized as an important factor in improving their performance. In this work, we assess the impact of incorporating explicit electrostatics and environment-dependence of atomic charges by comparing short-ranged Moment Tensor Potentials (MTPs) with electrostatics-augmented MTPs, including fixed-charge and environment-dependent charge models. To this end, we employ D-optimality-based active learning (AL) to train short-ranged MTPs and extend the AL procedure, previously unavailable for long-range electrostatics-augmented MTPs, to these models, enabling largely automated generation of diverse training sets for pure ethylene carbonate (EC) and ethyl methyl carbonate (EMC), their mixtures, and LiPF6 solutions. For EC, EMC, and their mixtures, electrostatics-augmented MTPs achieve accuracy comparable to or better than that of their short-ranged counterparts while requiring fewer machine-learned parameters. For LiPF6 solutions, however, a notable improvement in accuracy is achieved only with environment-dependent charges, which also enhance stability in large-scale molecular dynamics simulations, unlike the fixed-charge model. The resulting short-ranged MTPs and environment-dependent-charge models reproduce experimental densities with mean absolute deviations of 0.2-6% and ionic conductivities with deviations of 11-15%, while capturing the experimentally observed temperature dependence of conductivity.
full_list.summary: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) combine near-ab initio accuracy with the computational efficiency of classical force fields, making them promising tools for modeling molecular liquids…
full_list.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：主动学习和高通量采样、分子动力学与有限温度轨迹。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对《Active learning and explicit electrostatics enable accurate modeling of electrolytes》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Inverse design of superconductors and semiconductors with differentiable foundation models
full_list.title_zh: 具有可微基础模型的超导体和半导体的逆向设计
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.09572v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Designing a crystal for a target property requires choosing its elements, stoichiometry, and atomic structure together, yet gradients exist only for the continuous structural variables. We introduce differentiable Equiformer fast effective-atom theory (DEFEAT), which lets a pretrained EquiformerV3 foundation model accept continuous species weights and site occupancies without retraining on fractional data, thereby enabling gradient-based materials optimization. Gradients from fine-tuned property models and a machine-learned energy penalty then guide updates to composition, atom count, atomic positions, and lattice vectors in a single optimization. In a search for phonon-mediated superconductors, density-functional perturbation theory on 45 structurally novel designs gives isotropic Allen-Dynes critical temperatures above 10 K for 39; the highest is 24.0 K for ZrTiNb2CN3, and H4LiPd3 (23.2 K) lies on the static DFT hull. In searches for photovoltaic absorbers, SCAN calculations confirm ten novel crystal structures with band gaps within 20% of a 1.34 eV target on their respective raw or empirically corrected scales, all within 70 meV/atom of the DFT hull, and show that the systematic gap error of the training functional propagates into the designs unless the objective corrects for it. Quasiharmonic free energies from machine-learned potentials further show that finite-temperature competition with solid phases can reorder candidates relative to the static hull.
full_list.abstract_zh: 设计具有目标特性的晶体需要同时选择其元素、化学计量和原子结构，但梯度仅存在于连续结构变量。我们引入了可微的 Equiformer 快速有效原子理论 (DEFEAT)，它使预训练的 EquiformerV3 基础模型接受连续的物种权重和位点占用，而无需对分数数据进行重新训练，从而实现基于梯度的材料优化。来自微调属性模型的梯度和机器学习的能量惩罚然后在单个优化中指导成分、原子计数、原子位置和晶格向量的更新。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 设计具有目标特性的晶体需要同时选择其元素、化学计量和原子结构，但梯度仅存在于连续结构变量。我们引入了可微的 Equiformer 快速有效原子理论 (DEFEAT)，它使预训练的 EquiformerV3 基础模型接受连续的物种权重和位点占用，而无需对分数数据进行重新训练，从而实现基于梯度的材料优化。来自微调属性模型的梯度和机器学习的能量惩罚然后在单个优化中指导成分、原子计数、原子位置和晶格向量的更新。在寻找声子介导的超导体时，对 45 种结构新颖的设计的密度泛函微扰理论给出了 39 种超过 10 K 的各向同性 Allen-Dynes 临界温度； ZrTiNb2CN3 的最高温度为 24.0 K，H4LiPd3 (23.2 K) 位于静态 DFT 壳上。在寻找光伏吸收器时，SCAN 计算确认了十种新颖的晶体结构，其带隙在各自原始或经验校正尺度上的 1.34 eV 目标的 20% 以内，全部在 DFT 外壳的 70 meV/原子内，并表明训练函数的系统带隙误差会传播到设计中，除非目标对其进行校正。来自机器学习势的准谐波自由能进一步表明，与固相的有限温度竞争可以相对于静态外壳重新排序候选者。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入非绝热分子动力学、电子—声子耦合、Wannier/GW-BSE 和载流子输运。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及声子、有限温度和输运性质, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“先用高精度电子结构和声子/电子—声子矩阵元建立小规模基准，再训练可迁移 Hamiltonian 或 ML 势，最后在长时间尺度非绝热 MD、输运或界面电荷转移中验证”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：非绝热分子动力学、电子—声子耦合、Wannier/GW-BSE 和载流子输运已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到卤化物钙钛矿、二维半导体、FeSe、光电界面和能源材料。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注声子、有限温度和输运性质, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的非绝热分子动力学、电子—声子耦合、Wannier/GW-BSE 和载流子输运嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在卤化物钙钛矿、二维半导体、FeSe、光电界面和能源材料中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“先用高精度电子结构和声子/电子—声子矩阵元建立小规模基准，再训练可迁移 Hamiltonian 或 ML 势，最后在长时间尺度非绝热 MD、输运或界面电荷转移中验证”补充训练/验证集，再比较《具有可微基础模型的超导体和半导体的逆向设计》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: TopoSHAP: Shapley for Explainable and Efficient Topological Deep Learning
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：TopoSHAP: Shapley for Explainable and Efficient Topological Deep Learning
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.08789v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Topological deep learning (TDL) extends learning on graphs, such as molecules or social networks, to higher-order structures, such as rings in a molecule or groups in a social network. Explaining which of these structures drive a model's predictions, and which architectural components matter most for its performance, remains challenging. We introduce TopoSHAP, an efficient and general explanation framework that addresses both questions across topological domains and model architectures. TopoSHAP-cell assigns Shapley values to topological data cells and extracts compact explanations. These explanations match or outperform graph-based counterparts on GraphXAI benchmark data while running up to 112× faster. They also reveal advantageous topological feature design, leading to measured improvements in explanation recovery and predictive accuracy. On the architecture side, TopoSHAP-neighbor explains how neighborhoods contribute to model performance, and turns these evaluations into a backward-elimination search that identifies smaller, competitive architectures early in training. This is up to 11.3× cheaper than traditional TDL training sweeps.

full_list.title_en: Emergent Low-Dimensional Topological Dynamics Dictate Generalization and Escape Mechanics in Billion-Parameter Neural Networks
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Emergent Low-Dimensional Topological Dynamics Dictate Generalization and Escape Mechanics in Billion-Parameter Neural Networks
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.08502v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The remarkable generalization of modern over-parameterized neural networks defies classical statistical learning bounds. Here we establish that optimization trajectories in billion-parameter models do not sample the ambient dimension R^N homogeneously; instead, they are dynamically constrained to a low-dimensional execution submanifold Mₑₓₑc (with empirically observed effective dimension dₑff le 12). By equipping the parameter space with a regularized Hessian metric gᵢⱼ = nablaᵢ nablaⱼ L + ϵ δᵢⱼ and analyzing stochastic Langevin diffusion on loss sublevel sets, we derive a rigorous Topological Generalization Bound grounded in projected subspace persistent homology. Furthermore, by linking Morse index transitions to Betti number annihilation (β₁ → 0), we formulate an exact mathematical mechanism for exponential escape from strict saddles under anisotropic noise. We validate our framework across 80+ architectures (ResNets, Vision Transformers, and 7B LLMs). To bridge theoretical topology with computational feasibility, we resolve the curse of dimensionality by computing projected persistent homology proxies via randomized Lanczos iterations restricted strictly within active Hessian subspaces. Building upon this mathematical foundation, we introduce Topological-Adaptive Optimization (Top-SGD and Top-AdamW)---a family of wrapper algorithms that dynamically modulate learning rates using active curvature signatures. Extensive benchmarks demonstrate a 14.1% reduction in total wall-clock training time on ImageNet with all computational and memory overheads fully accounted for. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/imslab-research/Topological-SGD.

full_list.title_en: Symmetry-Gated Sliding: Decoupling Interlayer Translation from Polarization Reversal in Boron Nitride Ferroelectrics
full_list.title_zh: 对称门控滑动：氮化硼铁电体中极化反转的层间平移解耦
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.09025v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electric-field-driven polarization switching in sliding ferroelectrics depends on how local interlayer motion is accommodated by the surrounding structure. Yet the relationship between sliding, domain-wall (DW) propagation, and collective domain evolution under changing vector fields remains unclear. Here, we show that local symmetry governs the coupling between field-induced forces and interlayer sliding, while DW connectivity determines how local motion contributes to net domain conversion. These effects are examined across three structural scales, from monodomains and isolated DWs to reconstructed moire networks. We investigate bilayer hexagonal boron nitride (h-BN) using molecular dynamics with a machine-learning interatomic potential that incorporates field-dependent electric enthalpy. An initially monodomain bilayer switches through directional wrinkling and interlayer sliding, while the barrier along a constrained flat path remains finite. Pre-existing DWs propagate with velocities governed by their shear and tensile character, and an additional in-plane field tunes wall velocity and width according to its orientation. In reconstructed triangular moire networks, shared junctions and boundary curvature mediate domain evolution and recovery after field removal or reversal. Most strikingly, a rotating in-plane field translates the layers and displaces the moiré nodes by approximately 1 AA yet leaves the AB/BA domain-area ratio without detectable change, because threefold connectivity cancels the contributions of individual walls. We term this response polarization-silent sliding. These results distinguish local sliding, DW translation, and net domain conversion as different responses to electric fields and establish how local structural symmetry and DW connectivity shape their selective control.
full_list.abstract_zh: 滑动铁电体中电场驱动的极化切换取决于周围结构如何适应局部层间运动。然而，变化矢量场下的滑动、畴壁（DW）传播和集体域演化之间的关系仍不清楚。在这里，我们表明局部对称性控制着场感生力和层间滑动之间的耦合，而 DW 连接性则决定了局部运动如何促进网络域转换。这些效应在三个结构尺度上进行了研究，从单域和孤立的 DW 到重建的莫尔网络。我们利用分子动力学和机器学习原子间势（结合了场相关电焓）研究双层六方氮化硼 (h-BN)。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 滑动铁电体中电场驱动的极化切换取决于周围结构如何适应局部层间运动。然而，变化矢量场下的滑动、畴壁（DW）传播和集体域演化之间的关系仍不清楚。在这里，我们表明局部对称性控制着场感生力和层间滑动之间的耦合，而 DW 连接性则决定了局部运动如何促进网络域转换。这些效应在三个结构尺度上进行了研究，从单域和孤立的 DW 到重建的莫尔网络。我们利用分子动力学和机器学习原子间势（结合了场相关电焓）研究双层六方氮化硼 (h-BN)。最初的单域双层通过定向起皱和层间滑动进行切换，而沿受约束的平坦路径的势垒保持有限。预先存在的 DW 以其剪切和拉伸特性控制的速度传播，并且附加的面内场根据壁的方向调整壁的速度和宽度。在重建的三角莫尔网络中，共享结点和边界曲率介导场去除或反转后域的演变和恢复。最引人注目的是，旋转的面内场平移层并将莫尔节点移动约 1 AA，但 AB/BA 域面积比没有可检测到的变化，因为三重连通性抵消了各个壁的贡献。我们将这种响应称为极化无声滑动。这些结果将局部滑动、DW 平移和网域转换区分为对电场的不同响应，并确定局部结构对称性和 DW 连接性如何塑造其选择性控制。
full_list.summary: 滑动铁电体中电场驱动的极化切换取决于周围结构如何适应局部层间运动。然而，变化矢量场下的滑动、畴壁（DW）传播和集体域演化之间的关系仍不清楚。在这里，我们表明局部对称性控制着场感生力和层间滑动之间的耦合，而 DW 连接性则决定了局部运动如何促进网络域转换。这些效应在三个结构尺度上进行了研究，从单域和孤立的 DW 到重建的莫尔网络。我们利用分子动力学和机器学习原子间势（结合了场相关电焓）研究双层六方氮化硼 (h-BN)。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题。从摘要能确认的线索包括：分子动力学与有限温度轨迹，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学, 二维滑移铁电、层间堆垛和畴壁在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”补充训练/验证集，再比较《对称门控滑动：氮化硼铁电体中极化反转的层间平移解耦》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Fortuitous Cancellation of Competing Effects in the Free Energy of Water Autoionization: Long-Range Electrostatics, System Size, and Nuclear Quantum Effects
full_list.title_zh: 水自电离自由能中竞争效应的偶然抵消：长程静电、系统尺寸和核量子效应
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.08874v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Few molecular processes are more fundamental to chemistry than the autoionization of water, whose equilibrium constant, K_w approx 10⁻¹⁴, underlies acid-base equilibria and the chemistry of life. Yet the molecular origins of the free energy cost of forming and separating ions remain incompletely understood. Efforts to explain it have been limited by the difficulty of modeling water reactivity in sufficient detail. Here we combine machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) with spectral adaptive biasing force enhanced sampling to connect proton transfer and water wire configurations to the underlying free energy landscape. We identify competing influences of long-range electrostatics, system size, temperature, and nuclear quantum motion on the predicted ionization thermodynamics. The free energy surface extends from neutral water to ions separated beyond the solvent-separated ion pair (SSIP). It reveals a transition state in which a proton is shared between the second and third molecules of a three-membered water wire. The contact ion pair is unstable and the SSIP only weakly metastable, so determining pK_w requires sampling longer wires. Long-range electrostatics raise the free energy at ion separations beyond 3,mathrmmathringA. Models with comparable force errors give substantially different free energy profiles in this region. Increasing system size lowers the calculated pK_w, while nuclear quantum effects bring it closer to experiment and reproduce the higher pK_w of D₂O relative to H₂O. These results establish a baseline for interpreting thermodynamic results from MLIP simulations in which charged and polar groups react and diffuse in finite cells. Our analysis also explains how cancellation among competing effects can yield ionization constants close to experiment even when simulations omit several physical contributions.
full_list.abstract_zh: 对于化学来说，很少有分子过程比水的自电离更重要，其平衡常数 K_w 约为 10⁻14，是酸碱平衡和生命化学的基础。然而，形成和分离离子的自由能成本的分子起源仍不完全清楚。由于难以足够详细地模拟水反应性，解释它的努力受到限制。在这里，我们将机器学习原子间势（MLIP）与光谱自适应偏置力增强采样相结合，将质子转移和水线配置与底层自由能景观连接起来。我们确定了长程静电、系统尺寸、温度和核量子运动对预测电离热力学的竞争影响。

full_list.title_en: From local learning to global electronic properties in large-scale systems
full_list.title_zh: 从本地学习到大规模系统中的全局电子特性
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.09153v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine learning from local atomic environments offers an efficient route to electronic structure, but evaluating global electronic properties in large systems remains computationally demanding. Here we combine real space charge density learning with stochastic propagation using Kohn-Sham Hamiltonians constructed from the predicted densities. The framework avoids target system self-consistent iterations and explicit diagonalization, while hierarchical blocking enables dense grid inference within limited GPU memory. We demonstrate density of states calculations for one million Si atoms and optical and transport calculations for over one hundred thousand atoms, without training separate models for each property. This framework extends the practical scale of electronic structure calculations within Kohn-Sham DFT, opening opportunities to investigate how atomic structure governs electronic, optical and transport properties at length scales relevant to real materials and devices.
full_list.abstract_zh: 来自局部原子环境的机器学习为电子结构提供了一条有效的途径，但评估大型系统中的全局电子特性仍然需要大量计算。在这里，我们使用根据预测密度构建的 Kohn-Sham 哈密顿量将真实空间电荷密度学习与随机传播结合起来。该框架避免了目标系统自洽迭代和显式对角化，而分层分块可以在有限的 GPU 内存内实现密集网格推理。我们演示了 100 万个 Si 原子的态密度计算以及超过 10 万个原子的光学和传输计算，而无需为每个属性训练单独的模型。

full_list.title_en: Universal Hamiltonian learning with rotational and basis equivariance
full_list.title_zh: 具有旋转和基方差的通用哈密顿学习
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2401.17015v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Deep learning has the potential to transform computational materials research by making electronic-structure calculations more efficient and scalable. The Hamiltonian matrix in the localized atomic-orbital basis is a promising target for deep-learning electronic structure, yet enforcing rotational equivariance can be computationally costly, and the matrix depends on the choice of basis set. Here we introduce DeepH-2, a physics-guided neural-network framework that reduces the computational cost of enforcing rotational equivariance through a local-coordinate formulation and incorporates basis equivariance by mapping a shared latent Hamiltonian to the target atomic-orbital basis. DeepH-2 achieves sub-meV test-set error on a diverse materials dataset and demonstrates transferability across material dimensions. These results highlight the value of encoding physics priors into deep-learning electronic structure models, and pave the way for developing the electronic-structure foundation models.
full_list.abstract_zh: 深度学习有可能通过提高电子结构计算的效率和可扩展性来改变计算材料的研究。局部原子轨道基中的哈密顿矩阵是深度学习电子结构的一个有希望的目标，但实施旋转等方差可能在计算上花费很大，并且矩阵取决于基集的选择。在这里，我们引入了DeepH-2 ，这是一个物理引导的神经网络框架，通过局部坐标公式降低了执行旋转等方差的计算成本，并通过将共享的潜在哈密顿函数映射到目标原子轨道基，结合了基方差。DeepH-2在不同的材料数据集上实现了亚meV测试集误差，并展示了跨材料尺寸的可转移性。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 深度学习有可能通过提高电子结构计算的效率和可扩展性来改变计算材料的研究。局部原子轨道基中的哈密顿矩阵是深度学习电子结构的一个有希望的目标，但实施旋转等方差可能在计算上花费很大，并且矩阵取决于基集的选择。在这里，我们引入了DeepH-2 ，这是一个物理引导的神经网络框架，通过局部坐标公式降低了执行旋转等方差的计算成本，并通过将共享的潜在哈密顿函数映射到目标原子轨道基，结合了基方差。DeepH-2在不同的材料数据集上实现了亚meV测试集误差，并展示了跨材料尺寸的可转移性。这些结果凸显了将物理先验编码到深度学习电子结构模型中的价值，为开发电子结构基础模型铺平了道路。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：有效哈密顿量或机器学习哈密顿量。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对《具有旋转和基方差的通用哈密顿学习》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Strain-Dependent Ionic Transport in Li3YCl6 Solid Electrolytes
full_list.title_zh: Li3YCl6 固体电解质中应变相关的离子传输
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2605.05603v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Solid-state batteries require electrolytes that sustain high ionic conductivity under the mechanical environment of a functioning cell. Lattice strain, arising from stack pressure, lattice mismatch at interfaces, and more importantly electrochemical cycling, can either enhance or suppress Li⁺ transport in solid electrolytes, yet how it couples to the underlying diffusion mechanism in Li3YCl6 remains poorly understood. Using Li3YCl6 halide superionic conductor, we address this with large-scale molecular dynamics simulations driven by an Atomic Cluster Expansion (ACE) machine learning interatomic potential trained on first-principles data. The ACE model faithfully reproduces experimental and ab initio structural, mechanical, and transport properties of Li3YCl6. Extending the simulations to high temperature reveals a crossover from predominantly one-dimensional hopping at low temperature toward diffusion through a connected three-dimensional pathway network at high temperature. Strain substantially modulates diffusivity: tensile strain enhances it while compressive strain suppresses it. Free-breakpoint model selection resolves two Arrhenius regimes for most strain states, and the fitted T_c varies nonmonotonically with strain. Strain modifies the effective activation energies and the accessibility of diffusion pathways in a temperature-dependent manner. These results quantify the strain sensitivity of ionic conductivity and diffusion pathways in Li3YCl6 solid-state electrolytes.
full_list.abstract_zh: 固态电池需要电解质在功能电池的机械环境下维持高离子电导率。由堆压、界面晶格失配以及更重要的是电化学循环引起的晶格应变可以增强或抑制固体电解质中的Li⁺传输，但它如何与Li3YCl6中的潜在扩散机制耦合仍然知之甚少。使用 Li3YCl6 卤化物超离子导体，我们通过由原子团簇扩展 (ACE) 机器学习原子间势驱动的大规模分子动力学模拟来解决这个问题，该模型是根据第一性原理数据训练的。 ACE 模型忠实地再现了 Li3YCl6 的实验和从头开始的结构、机械和输运特性。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 固态电池需要电解质在功能电池的机械环境下维持高离子电导率。由堆压、界面晶格失配以及更重要的是电化学循环引起的晶格应变可以增强或抑制固体电解质中的Li⁺传输，但它如何与Li3YCl6中的潜在扩散机制耦合仍然知之甚少。使用 Li3YCl6 卤化物超离子导体，我们通过由原子团簇扩展 (ACE) 机器学习原子间势驱动的大规模分子动力学模拟来解决这个问题，该模型是根据第一性原理数据训练的。 ACE 模型忠实地再现了 Li3YCl6 的实验和从头开始的结构、机械和输运特性。将模拟扩展到高温揭示了从低温下主要的一维跳跃到高温下通过连接的三维路径网络的扩散的交叉。应变显着调节扩散率：拉伸应变增强扩散率，而压缩应变抑制扩散率。自由断点模型选择解决了大多数应变状态的两个阿伦尼乌斯状态，并且拟合的 T_c 随应变非单调变化。应变以与温度相关的方式改变有效活化能和扩散路径的可达性。这些结果量化了 Li3YCl6 固态电解质中离子电导率和扩散路径的应变敏感性。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入非绝热分子动力学、电子—声子耦合、Wannier/GW-BSE 和载流子输运。从摘要能确认的线索包括：分子动力学与有限温度轨迹, 第一性原理标注与结构优化, 团簇展开与构型统计，以及声子、有限温度和输运性质对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“先用高精度电子结构和声子/电子—声子矩阵元建立小规模基准，再训练可迁移 Hamiltonian 或 ML 势，最后在长时间尺度非绝热 MD、输运或界面电荷转移中验证”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：非绝热分子动力学、电子—声子耦合、Wannier/GW-BSE 和载流子输运已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到卤化物钙钛矿、二维半导体、FeSe、光电界面和能源材料。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注声子、有限温度和输运性质在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的非绝热分子动力学、电子—声子耦合、Wannier/GW-BSE 和载流子输运嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在卤化物钙钛矿、二维半导体、FeSe、光电界面和能源材料中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“先用高精度电子结构和声子/电子—声子矩阵元建立小规模基准，再训练可迁移 Hamiltonian 或 ML 势，最后在长时间尺度非绝热 MD、输运或界面电荷转移中验证”补充训练/验证集，再比较《Li3YCl6 固体电解质中应变相关的离子传输》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Reversible Interchain Associations Dominate Plateau Elasticity in Conjugated Polymers
full_list.title_zh: 可逆链间缔合主导共轭聚合物的平台弹性
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.09810v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The modulus plateau is widely regarded as a hallmark of topological entanglement in homopolymer melts and has been used to identify entanglement in semiflexible conjugated polymers. Using regiorandom poly(3-alkylthiophenes) as a model system, we show that their plateau elasticity relaxes through an Arrhenius process decoupled from segmental and terminal dynamics, reorganizes persistently under mechanical perturbation, and varies systematically with side-chain length. These behaviors are hard to reconcile with a purely topological-entanglement picture and instead support a transient network dominated by reversible interchain associations, consistent with π-π interactions between conjugated backbone segments. The results thus demonstrate that plateau elasticity alone does not uniquely identify topological entanglement in conjugated polymers. More broadly, they identify the strength and lifetime of interchain association as molecular design parameters linking backbone packing to stress relaxation, viscoelastic properties, and processability in conjugated polymers, complementing their established role in electronic structure and charge transport.
full_list.abstract_zh: 模量平台被广泛认为是均聚物熔体中拓扑缠结的标志，并已用于识别半柔性共轭聚合物中的缠结。使用区域随机聚（3-烷基噻吩）作为模型系统，我们表明它们的平台弹性通过与链段和末端动力学解耦的阿伦尼乌斯过程松弛，在机械扰动下持续重组，并随着侧链长度系统地变化。这些行为很难与纯粹的拓扑纠缠图相协调，而是支持由可逆链间关联主导的瞬态网络，与共轭主链片段之间的 π-π 相互作用一致。因此，结果表明，平台弹性本身并不能唯一地识别共轭聚合物中的拓扑缠结。

full_list.title_en: Quantum-walk measurements with sequential imaging of the same atomic sample
full_list.title_zh: 对同一原子样品进行连续成像的量子行走测量
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.09618v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We demonstrate sequential single-atom-resolved imaging of the same ultracold atomic sample and apply this technique to quantum-walk measurements in an optical lattice. In quantum gas microscope experiments, fluorescence imaging provides microscopic information on atomic distributions but induces motional heating through photon scattering, making it difficult to reuse the same sample for subsequent quantum dynamics. To overcome this limitation, we apply Raman sideband cooling with parameters optimized for post-imaging cooling, enabling sequential single-atom-resolved measurements of the same sample. By optimizing the cooling parameters with machine learning, we achieve high fidelity over multiple imaging cycles. To demonstrate the capability of this technique, we measure one-dimensional quantum walks of single atoms in an optical lattice. By determining the initial atomic positions from fluorescence images, we extract quantum-walk transition probabilities without requiring deterministic preparation of the initial atomic positions. The observed dynamics agree with numerical simulations of quantum walks of single atoms. Our method provides a route toward reducing experimental overhead in quantum gas microscope studies requiring repeated acquisition of spatially resolved correlation data.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们展示了同一超冷原子样品的顺序单原子分辨成像，并将该技术应用于光学晶格中的量子行走测量。在量子气体显微镜实验中，荧光成像提供了原子分布的微观信息，但通过光子散射引起运动加热，使得很难在后续的量子动力学中重复使用相同的样品。为了克服这一限制，我们应用拉曼边带冷却，并针对成像后冷却优化了参数，从而能够对同一样品进行连续的单原子分辨测量。通过机器学习优化冷却参数，我们在多个成像周期中实现了高保真度。为了证明这项技术的能力，我们测量了光学晶格中单个原子的一维量子行走。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们展示了同一超冷原子样品的顺序单原子分辨成像，并将该技术应用于光学晶格中的量子行走测量。在量子气体显微镜实验中，荧光成像提供了原子分布的微观信息，但通过光子散射引起运动加热，使得很难在后续的量子动力学中重复使用相同的样品。为了克服这一限制，我们应用拉曼边带冷却，并针对成像后冷却优化了参数，从而能够对同一样品进行连续的单原子分辨测量。通过机器学习优化冷却参数，我们在多个成像周期中实现了高保真度。为了证明这项技术的能力，我们测量了光学晶格中单个原子的一维量子行走。通过从荧光图像中确定初始原子位置，我们提取量子行走跃迁概率，而不需要确定性地准备初始原子位置。观察到的动力学与单原子量子行走的数值模拟一致。我们的方法提供了一种减少量子气体显微镜研究中需要重复采集空间分辨相关数据的实验费用的途径。

full_list.title_en: Low-Rank Iteration for Efficient Calculations of Topological Surface States
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Low-Rank Iteration for Efficient Calculations of Topological Surface States
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.09165v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Surface states are hallmarks of topological phases, and their efficient computation is crucial for topology characterization. Conventional supercell methods (SCM) approximate semi-infinite systems as finite periodic ones, but suffer from high computational cost, artificial inter-surface coupling, and slow convergence near band edges. Recently, boundary problems for semi-infinite systems have been recast as block-tridiagonal equations and solved by the cyclic reduction method (CRM) and the transfer matrix method (TMM). However, these approaches remain resource-intensive, as fine-mesh discretization produces very large matrices. Recognizing the intrinsic sparsity and low rank of these matrices, we develop a low-rank iterative method (LIM) with stochastic trace estimation that substantially reduces complexity and memory without sacrificing accuracy, while remaining straightforwardly parallelizable. Benchmarks on 2D and 3D topological systems show orders-of-magnitude acceleration over CRM and TMM. LIM extends readily to heterostructures, defective interfaces, and non-Hermitian systems, providing an efficient platform for topological and plasmonic surface phenomena.

full_list.title_en: AutoREC: A reinforcement learning platform for equivalent circuit model generation
full_list.title_zh: AutoREC：用于生成等效电路模型的强化学习平台
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2604.27266v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: This paper introduces AutoREC, an open-source Python platform for developing, training and evaluating reinforcement learning (RL) agents that automatically generate equivalent circuit models (ECMs) from electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) data. Although ECMs are widely used to interpret EIS measurements, their identification typically relies on manual trial-and-error, requiring domain expertise and limiting scalability, particularly in autonomous experimental pipelines such as self-driving laboratories. In AutoREC, ECM generation is formulated as a Markov decision process in which an RL agent sequentially modifies a circuit topology based on the current state, available actions and feedback from the resulting model. The platform supports an end-to-end workflow encompassing EIS preprocessing with selectable impedance representations, agent setup and training, ECM generation for new measurements and visualization-based evaluation and analysis of agent decision-making. AutoREC implements a configurable Double Deep Q-Network agent with prioritized experience replay and a dedicated deadloop mitigation strategy for navigating the complex circuit-generation action space efficiently. To demonstrate the platform, we trained a representative agent on 1350 synthetic spectra from five reference circuit families, evaluated it on 150 held-out synthetic spectra and applied it to 32 previously unseen experimental spectra from battery, corrosion, oxygen evolution reaction and CO2 reduction systems. These case studies illustrate the end-to-end capabilities of AutoREC while revealing challenges associated with experimental complexity and limited training-data coverage. The demonstrated agent serves as a reference implementation; AutoREC provides an extensible foundation through which users can develop and evaluate agents tailored to their specific electrochemical systems and research objectives.

full_list.title_en: Electronic Bands and Altermagnetic State Modulation in a Se-Rich In₂Se₄/Cr₂SeO Heterostructure
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Electronic Bands and Altermagnetic State Modulation in a Se-Rich In₂Se₄/Cr₂SeO Heterostructure
full_list.abstract: Two-dimensional van der Waals (vdW) heterostructures provide a versatile platform for engineering electronic properties through interfacial charge redistribution and orbital hybridization. In this work, a Se-rich-designated In₂Se₄/Cr₂SeO vdW heterostructure is proposed and investigated using density functional theory. The In₂Se₄ layer serves as an electronically active interface in which the enhanced selenium sublattice provides Se-p states capable of interacting with the Cr-3d-derived states of an altermagnetic Cr₂SeO. A 1×1×1 In₂Se₄ monolayer and a strained (tensile in x and compressive in y) 1×2×1 Cr₂SeO cell were used to construct a supercell. The structural stability of the heterostructure is first evaluated through relaxation. The electronic properties are then characterized using spin-resolved band structures, projected density of states, orbital-resolved electronic states, and spatial charge density. The calculations reveal that interlayer coupling substantially modifies the electronic states near the Fermi level while retaining the characteristic spin-dependent structure of the Cr₂SeO layer. Overall, the heterostructure exhibits momentum-dependent semi-metallic/semiconducting behavior with strongly spin-selective local gaps. Se displacement in the In₂Se₄ monolayer acts as a symmetry and electrostatic control parameter that modifies the spin channels differently at different k-points. The resulting momentum-selective modification of Cr-derived states demonstrates the potential of Se-rich chalcogenide interfaces for tailoring the electronic structure of two-dimensional altermagnets. These findings suggest this heterostructure as a promising platform for investigating interfacial spin-dependent phenomena, provide insight into low-dimensional magnetic materials, and provide a theoretical foundation for nanoscale spintronic applications.

full_list.title_en: Driving Atomic Spins through Their Substrate Electrons
full_list.title_zh: 通过基底电子驱动原子自旋
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.09499v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Coherent control of single spins on surfaces has relied on decoupling them from the substrate with insulating films, which protects the spin but also removes any electronic means of addressing it. Here we show that a local electric potential can drive an adatom spin through the substrate electrons themselves. An exact reciprocity relation fixes the torque, which equals the change of the local electron density when the moment rotates; the drive map is thus a ground-state property that can be measured independently. The relation also implies sharp selection rules, since point-contact spins, spin-1/2 and the central transition of half-integer spins remain dark. On a normal metal the hybridization responsible for the drive also destroys coherence, but on a superconductor the drive survives while substrate damping is confined to subgap transitions. For atomically sharp tips we find Rabi frequencies of several MHz at RF amplitudes of tens of mV, with substrate-limited linewidths below 0.1~MHz, so that strong hybridization, usually the enemy of spin coherence, becomes an asset.
full_list.abstract_zh: 对表面上单个自旋的相干控制依赖于用绝缘膜将它们与基底解耦，这保护了自旋，但也消除了解决它的任何电子手段。在这里，我们证明局部电势可以通过基底电子本身驱动吸附原子自旋。精确的互易关系确定了扭矩，该扭矩等于力矩旋转时局部电子密度的变化；因此，驱动图是可以独立测量的基态特性。这种关系还意味着尖锐的选择规则，因为点接触自旋、自旋 1/2 和半整数自旋的中心过渡仍然是黑暗的。在普通金属上，负责驱动的杂化也会破坏相干性，但在超导体上，驱动仍然存在，而基底阻尼仅限于子间隙跃迁。

full_list.title_en: Exploring Variational Regularization of Krylov Subspaces
full_list.title_zh: 探索 Krylov 子空间的变分正则化
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.09229v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Krylov subspace methods efficiently approximate extremal eigenstates and eigenvalues of many-body Hamiltonians, but non-orthogonal bases can suffer from ill-conditioning. This challenge is amplified in quantum computing, where direct state access and thus straightforward orthogonalization are unavailable. We investigate a variational Krylov-like framework that iteratively optimizes a parametrized sequence of states to mimic Lanczos-like couplings while penalizing linear dependencies. Analyzed against exact Krylov and Lanczos on a finite Anderson impurity model, ansatz expressivity strongly influences the performance: Hamiltonian-inspired ansätze preserve Krylov-like convergence while improving the conditioning, whereas shallow ansätze remain stable but miss low-energy directions.
full_list.abstract_zh: Krylov 子空间方法可以有效地近似多体哈密顿量的极值本征态和本征值，但非正交基可能会受到病态条件的影响。这一挑战在量子计算中被放大，因为直接状态访问和直接正交化是不可用的。我们研究了一种类似 Krylov 的变分框架，它迭代优化参数化的状态序列以模拟 Lanczos 式的耦合，同时惩罚线性依赖性。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: Krylov 子空间方法可以有效地近似多体哈密顿量的极值本征态和本征值，但非正交基可能会受到病态条件的影响。这一挑战在量子计算中被放大，因为直接状态访问和直接正交化是不可用的。我们研究了一种类似 Krylov 的变分框架，它迭代优化参数化的状态序列以模拟 Lanczos 式的耦合，同时惩罚线性依赖性。在有限安德森杂质模型上针对精确的 Krylov 和 Lanczos 进行分析，ansatz 表达性强烈影响性能：受哈密顿启发的 ansätze 在改善调节的同时保留了类似 Krylov 的收敛性，而浅 ansätze 保持稳定，但错过了低能量方向。

full_list.title_en: Learning State Preparation Circuits for Quantum Phases of Matter
full_list.title_zh: 物质量子相的学习状态准备电路
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2410.23544v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Many-body ground state preparation is an important subroutine used in the simulation of physical systems. In this paper, we introduce a flexible and efficient framework for obtaining a state preparation circuit for a large class of many-body ground states. We introduce polynomial-time classical algorithms that take reduced density matrices over O(1)-sized balls as inputs, and output a circuit that prepares the global state. We introduce algorithms applicable to (i) short-range entangled states (e.g., states prepared by shallow quantum circuits in any number of dimensions, and more generally, invertible states) and (ii) long-range entangled ground states (e.g., the toric code on a disk). Both algorithms can provably find a circuit whose depth is asymptotically optimal. Our approach uses a variant of the quantum Markov chain condition that remains robust against constant-depth circuits. The robustness of this condition makes our method applicable to a large class of states, whilst ensuring a classically tractable optimization landscape.
full_list.abstract_zh: 多体基态准备是物理系统仿真中使用的重要子程序。在本文中，我们引入了一个灵活有效的框架，用于获得一大类多体基态的状态准备电路。我们引入了多项式时间经典算法，该算法以O （ 1 ）大小的球上的减小密度矩阵作为输入，并输出准备全局状态的电路。我们介绍了适用于（ i ）短程纠缠态（例如，由浅量子电路在任何维度上准备的状态，更一般地说，可逆状态）和（ ii ）长程纠缠基态（例如，磁盘上的环面代码）的算法。这两种算法都可以证明找到深度渐近最优的电路。

full_list.title_en: Momentum-space engineering in van der Waals heterostructures
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Momentum-space engineering in van der Waals heterostructures
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.09285v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Twenty years of graphene research have established Dirac fermions as a versatile platform for exploring quantum topological phenomena. Yet control over graphene's low-energy spectrum mostly follows the route of miniband engineering using real-space superlattices. Here we introduce a complementary approach based on momentum-space 'Umklapp' band engineering. This is realised by matching reciprocal space positions of band edges of two adjacent highly incommensurate 2D crystals to coincide upon a boost from their Bragg vectors, creating resonant interlayer hybridisation that qualitatively reconstructs their spectra. To demonstrate this approach experimentally, we use monolayer graphene on MoS₂, twisted such that MoS₂ Q-valley states are brought by Umklapp into energy-momentum resonance with graphene's Dirac cones. The ensuing hybridization results in the formation of a clear additional Dirac-like spectral feature, identified by a distinct Landau-level fan and Shubnikov-de Haas oscillations characteristic to Berry phase π electrons. These new topological spectral features create a spin-valley locked Ising system which is robust against small twist-angle variations that can be further tuned by an external displacement field. More broadly, Umklapp band engineering offers a practical strategy for tailoring the electronic structure in van der Waals heterostructures, expanding the design space of quantum materials beyond moiré superlattices and weak proximity effects.

full_list.title_en: Accurate description of the electronic states of the VB⁻ center in hBN by wavefunction theory
full_list.title_zh: 波函数理论准确描述六方氮化硼VB⁻中心电子态
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2605.04283v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Ensembles of negatively charged boron vacancy (VB⁻) centers in hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) have emerged as a two-dimensional spin qubit system interfaced with optics to advance nanoscale quantum sensing. However, a comprehensive description of its optically detected magnetic resonance (ODMR) signal remains challenging due to the strongly correlated nature of the excited electronic states involved in its optical cycle. In this work, we model the energetics, structural relaxation, and transition rates of the VB⁻ center using a high-level wave-function-based electron correlation method (CASSCF-NEVPT2). We provide a thorough analysis of the excited state fine structure and pseudo Jahn-Teller effects, singlet-triplet quasi-degeneracies, photoluminescence parameters, intersystem crossing pathways, and stress-dependence of the fine structure and decay parameters. Our findings not only clarify the fundamental behavior of the VB⁻ center in hBN but also establish the theoretical foundation for advancing the VB⁻ center's readout for integrated 2D quantum sensors.
full_list.abstract_zh: 六方氮化硼（hBN）中带负电的硼空位（VB⁻）中心的集合已成为与光学接口的二维自旋量子位系统，以推进纳米级量子传感。然而，由于其光学循环中所涉及的激发电子态的强相关性，对其光学检测到的磁共振（ODMR）信号的全面描述仍然具有挑战性。在这项工作中，我们使用基于高级波函数的电子相关方法 (CASSCF-NEVPT2) 对 VB⁻ 中心的能量、结构弛豫和跃迁速率进行建模。

full_list.title_en: Modular Hamiltonian and Typicality of Degenerate States
full_list.title_zh: 模哈密顿量和简并态的典型性
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.09595v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Free fermions exhibit Eigenstate Typicality (ET) meaning that the reduced density matrix, ρ, of a small spatial subsystem of a sl single, typical, excited energy eigenstate is gaussian with a modular hamiltonian, h equiv -log ρ, asymptotically proportional to the free fermion hamiltonian. In effect, the ET may be thought of as providing an independent route to establishing the Fermi-Dirac (FD) distribution for free fermions. We revisit this argument for fermions belonging to a superposition of degenerate eigenstates. Specifically, we show that the modular hamiltonian corresponding to a superposition of degenerate eigenstates in a 1-d free fermion lattice system is interacting, and therefore the reduced density matrix for the subsystem is not gaussian. Measurements of the single particle distribution of a small subsystem would then exhibit non-thermal deviations from the FD distribution. These features may be traced to a violation of Wick's theorem for the chosen excited state. We develop a perturbation theory for the modular hamiltonian corresponding to a weak mixture of degenerate states and study the modular hamiltonian (exactly) computationally. Finally, we speculate that initial conditions in a realistic fermi system evolving towards equilibrium might be encoded in the interaction terms of the modular hamiltonian and consequent correlations of fermions.
full_list.abstract_zh: 自由费米子表现出本征态典型性 (ET)，这意味着 sl 单一、典型、激发能量本征态的小空间子系统的约简密度矩阵 ρ 是高斯分布，具有模哈密顿量 h equal -log ρ ，与自由费米子哈密顿量渐近成比例。实际上，ET 可以被认为提供了建立自由费米子的费米-狄拉克 (FD) 分布的独立途径。我们重新审视费米子属于简并本征态叠加的论证。具体来说，我们表明，对应于一维自由费米子晶格系统中简并本征态叠加的模哈密顿量是相互作用的，因此该子系统的约简密度矩阵不是高斯分布的。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 自由费米子表现出本征态典型性 (ET)，这意味着 sl 单一、典型、激发能量本征态的小空间子系统的约简密度矩阵 ρ 是高斯分布，具有模哈密顿量 h equal -log ρ ，与自由费米子哈密顿量渐近成比例。实际上，ET 可以被认为提供了建立自由费米子的费米-狄拉克 (FD) 分布的独立途径。我们重新审视费米子属于简并本征态叠加的论证。具体来说，我们表明，对应于一维自由费米子晶格系统中简并本征态叠加的模哈密顿量是相互作用的，因此该子系统的约简密度矩阵不是高斯分布的。然后，对小型子系统的单粒子分布的测量将表现出与 FD 分布的非热偏差。这些特征可以追溯到违反所选激发态的威克定理。我们开发了一种对应于简并态弱混合的模哈密顿量的微扰理论，并通过计算（精确地）研究了模哈密顿量。最后，我们推测，现实费米系统中向平衡演化的初始条件可能被编码在模哈密顿量的相互作用项和随之而来的费米子相关性中。

full_list.title_en: A Quantum Mechanical Description of Active Matter
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：A Quantum Mechanical Description of Active Matter
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.09861v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The natural environments habitable to life are inseparable from dissipative and entropic forces, which mandate active matter to operate on constant fluxes of energy and momentum to survive and propagate through spacetime. In contrast to fundamental particles which are characterized by energy and momentum, we postulate that energy expenditure rate and momentum generation rate are the fundamental dynamical quantities driving this evolution of swimming active matter and accordingly construct the corresponding Lagrangian and Hamiltonian of motion of the active matter. Furthermore, living systems broadly employ periodic, non-repeating motion for both locomotion and various biological functions, with meaningful information stored in the periods of these functions. Consequently, analyzing these dynamics in the Fourier space lands us at the familiar tools of the operator based, quantum mechanics. This is accomplished by introducing a complex field to describe the evolving probability distribution of a single unit, as well as the population density of mutually non-interacting active particles under the constraint of scarce resources. The resulting single-unit wavefunction evolves analogously to the Dirac equation with minimal coupling, wherein gauge symmetry reflects the generality of the governing equations across arbitrary resource landscapes. Additionally, we present a Schrödinger-like equation where the effective potential term represents the environmentally mandated, non-motile base metabolic rate. Finally, we formalize the bidirectional coupling between active swimmers and the surrounding fluid via a multipole expansion of the active force with an emphasis on force monopoles and dipoles, where each pole corresponds to a distinct mode of active motility.

full_list.title_en: Bichromatic light-induced electronic torques on the Néel vector in Rashba magnetic multipoles from p-wave magnets to i-wave altermagnets
full_list.title_zh: 从 p 波磁体到 i 波交替磁体的 Rashba 磁多极子中 Néel 矢量上的双色光感应电子扭矩
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.08761v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Light can control magnetic order on ultrafast timescales, but for a two-dimensional magnet with an out-of-plane order parameter boldsymbol Nparallelhat z, the inverse Faraday field is collinear with boldsymbol N and gives no transverse torque. Here we show that bichromatic (ω,bω) light generates electronic torques perpendicular to boldsymbol N in Rashba-coupled magnetic multipoles, from p-wave (n=1) magnets to i-wave (n=6) altermagnets. Beyond high-frequency effective fields, we evaluate the exact Floquet response and the generalized torque per occupied electron, for prescribed occupations. The momentum-dependent exchange terms dominate this Fermi-sea torque and remove the leading-order zeros (amplitude-ratio blindspots) of the momentum-independent field in the channels tested. For out-of-plane boldsymbol N, rotational symmetry permits a transverse torque only if gcd(n,b+1)=1 for counter-rotating beams or gcd(n,b-1)=1 for co-rotating beams. For in-plane boldsymbol N, the Fermi sea also gives a torque component along hat z that the momentum-independent field cannot produce. We classify the active channels, with n=1,dots,6 and b=1,dots,7, by frequency scaling and origin (cycle-averaged versus oscillating exchange). As a control, a Rashba ferromagnet (n=0) has one symmetry-allowed out-of-plane channel and a weak in-plane response without a selection rule. Finite-momentum occupied-state physics is therefore essential for light-driven torques in unconventional magnets, and the exact Floquet calculation validates and extends the high-frequency description.
full_list.abstract_zh: 光可以在超快时间尺度上控制磁序，但对于具有平面外序参数粗体符号 Nparallelhat z 的二维磁体，反法拉第场与粗体符号 N 共线，并且不给出横向扭矩。在这里，我们表明，从 p 波 (n=1) 磁体到 i 波 (n=6) 交流磁体，双色 (ω,bω) 光在 Rashba 耦合磁多极中产生垂直于粗体符号 N 的电子扭矩。除了高频有效场之外，我们还评估了规定职业的精确 Floquet 响应和每个占据电子的广义扭矩。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 光可以在超快时间尺度上控制磁序，但对于具有平面外序参数粗体符号 Nparallelhat z 的二维磁体，反法拉第场与粗体符号 N 共线，并且不给出横向扭矩。在这里，我们表明，从 p 波 (n=1) 磁体到 i 波 (n=6) 交流磁体，双色 (ω,bω) 光在 Rashba 耦合磁多极中产生垂直于粗体符号 N 的电子扭矩。除了高频有效场之外，我们还评估了规定职业的精确 Floquet 响应和每个占据电子的广义扭矩。动量相关交换项支配着费米海扭矩，并消除了测试通道中动量无关场的前导零点（振幅比盲点）。对于面外粗体符号 N，仅当反向旋转梁的 gcd(n,b+1)=1 或同向旋转梁的 gcd(n,b-1)=1 时，旋转对称才允许横向扭矩。对于面内粗体符号 N，费米海还给出了沿 z 轴的扭矩分量，这是动量无关场无法产生的。我们通过频率缩放和原点（周期平均与振荡交换）对活动通道进行分类，其中 n=1,dots,6 和 b=1,dots,7。作为对照，Rashba 铁磁体 (n=0) 具有一个对称允许的面外通道和弱面内响应，无需选择规则。因此，有限动量占据态物理对于非常规磁体中的光驱动扭矩至关重要，并且精确的 Floquet 计算验证并扩展了高频描述。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 非共线磁性、DMI/Kitaev 相互作用和交替磁性在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《从 p 波磁体到 i 波交替磁体的 Rashba 磁多极子中 Néel 矢量上的双色光感应电子扭矩》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Coexistence of antiferromagnetism and topological s+d+id superconductivity in twisted cuprate bilayers
full_list.title_zh: 扭曲铜酸盐双层中反铁磁性和拓扑 s+d+id 超导的共存
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.09469v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the interplay between antiferromagnetism and topological superconductivity in twisted cuprate bilayers. We demonstrate how topological s+d+id superconductivity is induced by a twist of θ sim 45^circ in a microscopic t-J type model of cuprate bilayers, where it robustly coexists with antiferromagnetic order at low hole doping. This novel pairing state becomes physically accessible at realistic interlayer couplings in the overdoped regime. Crucially, it displays a characteristic 2-fold rotational symmetry in angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES) not observed in the competing time-reversal symmetry breaking d+id or s+id states previously found. A finite Josephson effect at 45^circ twist together with signatures in scanning tunneling spectroscopy of its two Majorana edge modes identifies this topological s+d+id state unambiguously.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们研究了扭曲铜酸盐双层中反铁磁性和拓扑超导性之间的相互作用。我们展示了拓扑 s+d+id 超导性是如何在铜双层微观 t-J 型模型中通过 θ sim 45^circ 的扭曲而诱发的，其中它在低空穴掺杂下与反铁磁序稳健地共存。这种新颖的配对状态在过掺杂状态下的实际层间耦合中变得物理上可访问。至关重要的是，它在角度分辨光电子能谱 (ARPES) 中显示出特征性的 2 重旋转对称性，而在之前发现的打破 d+id 或 s+id 态的竞争时间反转对称性中未观察到这种特征。

full_list.title_en: Controlled spin-torque driven domain wall motion using staggered magnetic nanowires
full_list.title_zh: 使用交错磁性纳米线的受控自旋扭矩驱动畴壁运动
full_list.abstract: arXiv:1908.09304v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: The growing demand for storage, due to big data applications, cannot be met by hard disk drives. Domain wall (DW) memory devices such as racetrack memory offer an alternative route to achieve high capacity storage. In DW memory, control of domain wall positions and their motion using spin-transfer torque are important challenges. In this paper, we demonstrate controlled domain wall motion using spin-transfer torque in staggered magnetic nanowires. The devices, fabricated using electron-beam lithography, were tested using a magneto-optical Kerr microscopy and electrical transport measurements. The depinning current, pinning potential and thermal stability were found to depend on the device dimensions of the staggering nanowires. Thus, the proposed staggering configuration helps to fine-tune the properties of domain wall devices for memory applications.
full_list.abstract_zh: 硬盘驱动器无法满足大数据应用带来的日益增长的存储需求。赛道存储器等域壁（ DW ）存储器设备提供了实现高容量存储的替代途径。在DW存储器中，使用自旋转移扭矩控制畴壁位置及其运动是重要的挑战。在本文中，我们演示了使用自旋转移扭矩在交错磁性纳米线中的受控畴壁运动。使用电子束光刻制造的器件使用磁光克尔显微镜和电传输测量进行了测试。发现衰减电流、钉扎电位和热稳定性取决于惊人的纳米线的器件尺寸。因此，所提出的交错配置有助于微调用于内存应用的域壁设备的属性。

full_list.title_en: Disentangling Spin and Orbital Contributions in the Search for Altermagnetic Terahertz Conversion in RuO2
full_list.title_zh: 解开自旋和轨道贡献，寻找 RuO2 中的交变磁太赫兹转换
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.09098v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Rutile RuO2 has emerged as a prominent candidate altermagnet, yet the microscopic origin of its reported charge-angular-momentum conversion remains unsettled. Recent theoretical and experimental advances have highlighted a potentially dominant role of orbital transport, raising a fundamental ambiguity between spin- and orbital-mediated conversion in RuO2. Here, we report the first experimental disentanglement of the spin- and orbital-to-charge conversion channels in RuO2 heterostructures using terahertz emission spectroscopy. We identify Fe as a predominantly spin-current injector, whereas Ni and permalloy predominantly inject orbital currents, revealing a substantial orbital contribution to ultrafast terahertz emission. Under controlled spin-current injection, we find no evidence for inverse altermagnetic spin-splitting effect. Instead, the observed anisotropy is consistent with an anisotropic inverse spin Hall response that is strongly conditioned by the near-interface environment. Under orbital-current injection, the anisotropy is markedly weaker, indicating that orbital-to-charge conversion is largely isotropic in RuO2. Our results establish orbital transport and interface-conditioned spin Hall conversion as key to terahertz emission from RuO2, underscoring the need to disentangle spin, orbital, and interfacial contributions before assigning anisotropy to altermagnetism.
full_list.abstract_zh: 金红石 RuO2 已成为一种重要的候选交流磁体，但其所报道的电荷-角动量转换的微观起源仍然悬而未决。最近的理论和实验进展强调了轨道传输的潜在主导作用，从而在 RuO2 中自旋和轨道介导的转化之间提出了根本性的模糊性。在这里，我们报告了使用太赫兹发射光谱首次实验解开 RuO2 异质结构中的自旋和轨道到电荷转换通道。我们将 Fe 确定为主要的自旋电流注入器，而 Ni 和坡莫合金主要注入轨道电流，揭示了轨道对超快太赫兹发射的重要贡献。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质, 非共线磁性、DMI/Kitaev 相互作用和交替磁性在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《解开自旋和轨道贡献，寻找 RuO2 中的交变磁太赫兹转换》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Enforcing Symmetries on Pre-trained ML Models for Physics
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Enforcing Symmetries on Pre-trained ML Models for Physics
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.08992v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Post-hoc group averaging (or test-time augmentation) is a simple way to impose symmetry on a trained predictor without changing its architecture or retraining it. For finite and compact groups, averaging over a normalized Haar measure on the group gives the Reynolds operator: a canonical projection onto invariant or equivariant predictors with known non-increasing risk guarantees under certain assumptions. This paper provides numerical experiments on physics emulation models that demonstrate the effectiveness of the approach in this setting. We then extend this framework to non-compact group symmetries. For non-compact groups, the Haar measure cannot be normalized, so group averaging cannot be defined in the same way. We replace it with three alternatives: the Weyl unitary trick (which requires complexifying the space and extending the predictor), a data-dependent orthogonal projection (which involves a non-trivial optimization on the space of invariant or equivariant functions), and a frame averaging approach (which involves mapping each point to a set of orbit representatives). We illustrate the constructions theoretically and empirically on the unit-rescaling group and the Lorentz group. Our results show that in the non-compact case, the Weyl trick and frame averaging do not provide a consistent improvement over the baseline, except where the test data is out-of-distribution (an orders-of-magnitude improvement in this case) and, for the Weyl trick, in low-data regimes. The orthogonal projection can provide improvements in-distribution and out-of-distribution. We also observe that models trained directly on invariant features matched or beat the projection of an unconstrained one. We conclude that post-hoc symmetrization extends to non-compact groups, but it does not consistently outperform training a symmetric model.

full_list.title_en: Exciton design via topological spin textures
full_list.title_zh: 通过拓扑自旋纹理进行激子设计
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.09800v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Excitons carry energy and information through a semiconductor without carrying charge. This makes them attractive for optoelectronics, but also hard to guide. Magnetic skyrmions, on the other hand, are moved by small electrical currents. Here we develop a theory of excitons interacting with a skyrmion in which the electron and the hole are treated as distinct constituents, each with its own spin--orbit coupling. We find that the topology of the skyrmion is transferred to the exciton only when the exchange coupling exceeds the relevant spin--orbit splitting. The exciton then experiences a full flux quantum, with opposite signs in the two valleys. The quantum metric of the spin texture creates a ring-shaped barrier that traps excitons, whereas the topological charge fixes the angular momentum of the trapped states and hence their optical selection rules. Because the trap moves with the skyrmion, excitons can be transported by current pulses, and small skyrmions accommodate a single exciton, which opens the door for potential hybrid applications in future information technology intertwining topological magnetic bits with optical excitations.
full_list.abstract_zh: 激子通过半导体携带能量和信息而不携带电荷。这使得它们对光电子学很有吸引力，但也很难引导。另一方面，磁性斯格明子由小电流移动。在这里，我们发展了一种激子与斯格明子相互作用的理论，其中电子和空穴被视为不同的成分，每个成分都有自己的自旋轨道耦合。我们发现，只有当交换耦合超过相关的自旋轨道分裂时，斯格明子的拓扑才会转移到激子。然后激子经历全通量量子，在两个谷中具有相反的符号。

full_list.title_en: Helical magnetism from sliding Luttinger liquids in hole-doped twisted bilayer WTe₂
full_list.title_zh: 空穴掺杂扭曲双层 WTe2 中滑动路廷格液体产生的螺旋磁性
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.09462v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate carrier-mediated helical magnetism in hole-doped twisted bilayer WTe₂ coupled to localized moments. The itinerant carriers are described by a valleyless two-flavor sliding Luttinger liquid. Via the feedback mechanism of the helical order formed within individual channels, we show that the interchannel spin susceptibility mediates a Ruderman-Kittel-Kasuya-Yosida interaction between localized moments that can stabilize a coherent helical magnetic texture across the coupled-wire array. A spin-wave analysis of the ordered state allows us to estimate the magnon energies and helix-ordering scale. The magnon energies depend on the carrier interactions with representative values falling in the microwave regime, suggesting possible detection by magnetic-resonance techniques. The helical order partially gaps the carrier spectrum and renormalizes the spin-correlation and relaxation exponents. These results identify twisted bilayer WTe₂ as a tunable low-dimensional platform for realizing and probing carrier-mediated helical magnetism.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们研究了与局域矩耦合的空穴掺杂扭曲双层 WTe2 中载流子介导的螺旋磁性。流动载体由无谷的两种风味滑动Luttinger液体描述。通过各个通道内形成的螺旋顺序的反馈机制，我们表明通道间自旋磁化率介导了局部矩之间的 Ruderman-Kittel-Kasuya-Yosida 相互作用，可以稳定耦合线阵列上的相干螺旋磁纹理。有序态的自旋波分析使我们能够估计磁振子能量和螺旋有序尺度。磁振子能量取决于载流子与落在微波范围内的代表值的相互作用，这表明可以通过磁共振技术进行检测。

full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《空穴掺杂扭曲双层 WTe2 中滑动路廷格液体产生的螺旋磁性》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: High-Volume Wurtzite MnSe in MnSe/CdSe Superlattices: Structure, Magnetism and Optical Response
full_list.title_zh: MnSe/CdSe 超晶格中的高体积纤锌矿 MnSe：结构、磁性和光学响应
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.09509v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Polymorphism in Mn-based chalcogenides offers access to magnetic semiconductors with distinct crystal symmetries, polar structures, and different magnetic orders. In particular, wurtzite MnSe exhibits an appealing interplay of electric polarization and several competing magnetic phases including altermagnetic order. However, stabilizing metastable polymorphs, such as wurtzite MnSe, in experimentally useful volumes remains challenging. Here, we show that a nanoscale-period MnSe/CdSe superlattice stabilizes wurtzite MnSe over micrometer-scale total thickness while suppressing the formation of the thermodynamically favored rock-salt phase. The increased magnetic volume enables bulk-sensitive characterization of this polar polymorph. The room-temperature lattice parameters of wurtzite MnSe are studied by independent experimental techniques and determined to be a = (4.18 ± 0.03),mathringA and c = (6.78 ± 0.03), mathringA. SQUID magnetometry reveals antiferromagnetic ordering with T_N = 62,K, which is accompanied by an anomaly of the MnSe lattice parameter, as oberved by temperature-dependent X-ray diffraction. Optical measurements reveal excitonic transitions pointing to the band gap at around 3.4 eV. These results highlight the utility and importance of heterostructure engineering for detailed studies of metastable phases of magnetic semiconductors, in particular wurtzite MnSe.
full_list.abstract_zh: 锰基硫族化物中的多晶型现象提供了获得具有不同晶体对称性、极性结构和不同磁序的磁性半导体的途径。特别是，纤锌矿 MnSe 表现出引人注目的电极化和包括交变磁序在内的几个竞争磁相的相互作用。然而，在实验有用的体积中稳定亚稳态多晶型物（例如纤锌矿锰硒）仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们发现纳米级周期 MnSe/CdSe 超晶格可以在微米级总厚度上稳定纤锌矿 MnSe，同时抑制热力学上有利的岩盐相的形成。增加的磁体积使得能够对这种极性多晶型物进行体敏感表征。

full_list.title_en: Indirect optical manipulation of the antiferromagnetic order of insulating NiO by ultrafast interfacial energy transfer
full_list.title_zh: 通过超快界面能量转移间接光学操纵绝缘 NiO 的反铁磁序
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2205.02686v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We report the ultrafast, (sub)picosecond reduction of the antiferromagnetic order of the insulating NiO thin film in a Pt/NiO bilayer. This reduction of the antiferromagnetic order is not present in pure NiO thin films after a strong optical excitation. This ultrafast phenomenon is attributed to an ultrafast and highly efficient energy transfer from the optically excited electron system of the Pt layer into the NiO spin system. We propose that this energy transfer is mediated by a stochastic exchange scattering of hot Pt electrons at the Pt/NiO interface.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们报告了 Pt/NiO 双层中绝缘 NiO 薄膜的反铁磁序的超快、（亚）皮秒降低。在强光激发后，纯 NiO 薄膜中不存在反铁磁序的降低。这种超快现象归因于从 Pt 层的光激发电子系统到 NiO 自旋系统的超快且高效的能量转移。我们认为这种能量转移是由 Pt/NiO 界面处热 Pt 电子的随机交换散射介导的。

full_list.title_en: Interface-driven second harmonic generation in indium tin oxide/gold nanolayers: density and mass discontinuities matter
full_list.title_zh: 氧化铟锡/金纳米层中界面驱动的二次谐波产生：密度和质量不连续性很重要
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.09471v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Second harmonic generation from transparent conductive oxides and metals is traditionally attributed to Coulomb, magnetic Lorentz, and convective sources. We show that this picture is incomplete in deeply subwavelength indium tin oxide/gold bilayers. Measurements reveal two robust spectral features, a broad maximum near 1000 nm and an epsilon-near-zero peak near 1350 nm, that persist across wide variations in material and excitation parameters. Hydrodynamic-Maxwell simulations identify an interface-specific convective mechanism activated by freeelectron density and effective-mass discontinuities at the oxide-metal boundary. As electronic homogenization develops across the bilayer, the response evolves toward one described by conventional Coulomb, Lorentz, and leading convective terms. These results establish second harmonic generation as a sensitive probe of interface-driven nonlinearities and suggest a broader role for electronic discontinuities in shaping nonlinear optical processes at surface and buried material interfaces.
full_list.abstract_zh: 透明导电氧化物和金属产生的二次谐波传统上归因于库仑、磁洛伦兹和对流源。我们证明这张图片在深亚波长氧化铟锡/金双层中是不完整的。测量揭示了两个强大的光谱特征，即 1000 nm 附近的宽最大值和 1350 nm 附近的 epsilon 近零峰值，这些特征在材料和激发参数的广泛变化中持续存在。流体动力学-麦克斯韦模拟确定了由氧化物-金属边界处的自由电子密度和有效质量不连续性激活的界面特定对流机制。

full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《氧化铟锡/金纳米层中界面驱动的二次谐波产生：密度和质量不连续性很重要》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Ion Redistribution and Lattice-Distortion-Modulated d-Electron Correlation in Layered Multiferroic ABP₂S₆ Probed by X-ray Photoelectron Spectroscopy
full_list.title_zh: X 射线光电子能谱探测层状多铁性 ABP2S₆ 中的离子重新分布和晶格畸变调制 d 电子相关性
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.08728v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Ferroelectric phase transitions are driven by ion displacement-induced symmetry breaking, yet their chemical signatures are rarely probed directly at the atomic level. Here, we establish temperature-dependent X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) as a powerful and quantitative probe of ferroelectric phase transitions by tracking ion migration-induced changes in local chemical environments. Using van der Waals (vdW) layered ABP₂S₆ materials as a model system, we systematically compare CuCrP₂S₆ (CCPS), which undergoes a ferroelectric phase transition, with AgCrP₂S₆ (ACPS), which remains paraelectric over the same temperature range. While ACPS exhibits only smooth trivial thermal broadening and shifts in core-level spectra, CCPS shows pronounced and enormously large temperature-dependent XPS anomalies across the ferroelectric transition, demonstrating that XPS is intrinsically sensitive to ferroelectric order. Detailed analysis of the Cu 2p spectra reveals that these anomalies originate from temperature-driven Cu⁺ ion migration associated with polarization switching, whereas concurrent changes in the Cr core levels reflect secondary lattice squeezing and modulation of d-electron correlation induced by Cu displacement. Supported by a ferroelectric structural model, we further correlate XPS binding-energy shifts with the magnitude of Cu-ion migration, enabling a quantitative estimation of ionic displacement directly from spectroscopic observables. This work also highlights the rich information provided by temperature-dependent XPS for detecting and quantifying ferroelectric phase transitions and ion migration, offering a general chemical probe for ferroic materials and ion-displacement-driven phase transitions.
full_list.abstract_zh: 铁电相变是由离子位移引起的对称性破缺驱动的，但它们的化学特征很少在原子水平上直接探测。在这里，我们通过跟踪局部化学环境中离子迁移引起的变化，建立了温度依赖性 X 射线光电子能谱 (XPS) 作为铁电相变的强大定量探针。使用范德华 (vdW) 层状 ABP2S₆ 材料作为模型系统，我们系统地比较了经历铁电相变的 CuCrP2S₆ (CCPS) 与在相同温度范围内保持顺电性的 AgCrP2S₆ (ACPS)。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 铁电相变是由离子位移引起的对称性破缺驱动的，但它们的化学特征很少在原子水平上直接探测。在这里，我们通过跟踪局部化学环境中离子迁移引起的变化，建立了温度依赖性 X 射线光电子能谱 (XPS) 作为铁电相变的强大定量探针。使用范德华 (vdW) 层状 ABP2S₆ 材料作为模型系统，我们系统地比较了经历铁电相变的 CuCrP2S₆ (CCPS) 与在相同温度范围内保持顺电性的 AgCrP2S₆ (ACPS)。虽然 ACPS 仅表现出平滑的微不足道的热展宽和核心能级光谱的变化，但 CCPS 在整个铁电转变过程中表现出明显且巨大的温度依赖性 XPS 异常，这表明 XPS 本质上对铁电顺序敏感。对 Cu 2p 光谱的详细分析表明，这些异常现象源于与极化切换相关的温度驱动的 Cu⁺ 离子迁移，而 Cr 核心水平的并发变化反映了 Cu 位移引起的二次晶格挤压和 d 电子相关性的调制。在铁电结构模型的支持下，我们进一步将 XPS 结合能变化与铜离子迁移的幅度相关联，从而能够直接从光谱可观测值定量估计离子位移。这项工作还强调了温度依赖性 XPS 为检测和量化铁电相变和离子迁移提供的丰富信息，为铁电材料和离子位移驱动的相变提供了通用化学探针。

full_list.title_en: Josephson current along the domain walls in Weyl fully compensated ferrimagnet Ti₂MnAl
full_list.title_zh: 外尔完全补偿铁磁体 Ti2MnAl 中沿磁畴壁的约瑟夫森电流
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.09547v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We experimentally investigate Josephson current in planar Nb-Ti₂MnAl-Nb proximity devices, which are formed as junctions between superconducting niobium leads and single crystal flakes of the Weyl fully compensated ferrimagnet Ti₂MnAl. We demonstrate well developed Josephson effect for 2~μm distance between the niobium contacts on the Ti₂MnAl surface. The measured critical current dependence on the magnetic field I_c(B) shows strong anisotropy for two magnetic field orientations in respect to the Nb-Ti₂MnAl-Nb junction plane. For the parallel magnetic field, one can see standard Fraunhofer-like I_c(B) suppression pattern. In contrast, I_c(B) is qualitatively different in normal magnetic field, indicating non-trivial distribution of the Josephson current within the junction plane. From this anisotropy, long-range supercurrent and fast aperiodic fluctuations in I_c(B) we conclude that Josephson current is transferred by the chiral surface states, which emerge along the domain walls in topological compensated ferrimagnet Ti₂MnAl. The conclusion on the domain walls is supported by magnetization data for small Ti₂MnAl flakes.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们通过实验研究了平面 Nb-Ti2MnAl-Nb 邻近器件中的约瑟夫森电流，这些器件是作为超导铌引线和 Weyl 全补偿亚铁磁体 Ti2MnAl 的单晶薄片之间的结形成的。我们证明了 Ti2MnAl 表面铌接触点之间距离为 2~μm 时发展良好的约瑟夫森效应。测量的临界电流对磁场 I_c(B) 的依赖性显示出相对于 Nb-Ti2MnAl-Nb 结面的两个磁场方向的强各向异性。对于平行磁场，可以看到标准的类弗劳恩霍夫 I_c(B) 抑制模式。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们通过实验研究了平面 Nb-Ti2MnAl-Nb 邻近器件中的约瑟夫森电流，这些器件是作为超导铌引线和 Weyl 全补偿亚铁磁体 Ti2MnAl 的单晶薄片之间的结形成的。我们证明了 Ti2MnAl 表面铌接触点之间距离为 2~μm 时发展良好的约瑟夫森效应。测量的临界电流对磁场 I_c(B) 的依赖性显示出相对于 Nb-Ti2MnAl-Nb 结面的两个磁场方向的强各向异性。对于平行磁场，可以看到标准的类弗劳恩霍夫 I_c(B) 抑制模式。相比之下，I_c(B) 在正常磁场中具有质的不同，表明约瑟夫森电流在结平面内的非平凡分布。从 I_c(B) 的各向异性、长程超电流和快速非周期性涨落中，我们得出结论，约瑟夫森电流是通过手性表面态转移的，手性表面态沿着拓扑补偿亚铁磁体 Ti2MnAl 的磁畴壁出现。关于磁畴壁的结论得到了小 Ti2MnAl 薄片的磁化数据的支持。

full_list.title_en: Perfect Wave Transfer in Nonconformal Tomonaga-Luttinger Liquids
full_list.title_zh: 非共形 Tomonaga-Luttinger 液体中的完美波传输
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.09018v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Perfect wave transfer (PWT) reproduces spatial reflection at a common finite time under a fixed Hamiltonian. We classify this process for open compact bosons and inhomogeneous Tomonaga--Luttinger liquids, distinguishing transfer of oscillator and neutral observables from transfer on the charged field algebra. In the single-charge model, the first two notions coincide. Global transfer additionally requires rephasing of the compact zero mode. For regular reflection-symmetric channels, exact oscillator transfer forces an odd multiple of the optical crossing time and a strictly ordered, parity-compatible spectrum differing from the conformal ladder at only finitely many levels. This spectral condition is also sufficient when the Robin boundary data induced by the physical profile are included. Requiring Neumann conditions after the Liouville transformation instead forces conformality. We construct an explicit, regular one-defect family for every r>1/2. Its transfer parameters are precisely the reduced fractions r=p/q with odd numerator and denominator, with shortest transfer time pL/v₀. At the delay 3L/v₀, the r=3/5 profile has numerical contrast Kₘₐₓ/Kₘᵢₙsimeq 12.913, compared with 81 for r=3. Two independent conservative discretizations show second-order convergence on fixed mode bands. Occupation- and charge-constrained error estimates quantify robustness, while an exact homogeneous-chain calculation explains the J²/³ resolved-band scale also observed in the engineered channels. These results provide a spectral design method and finite-device benchmarks for quadratic quantum channels. An interacting microscopic realization remains open.
full_list.abstract_zh: 完美波传递 (PWT) 在固定哈密顿量下再现公共有限时间的空间反射。我们将这个过程分类为开放紧致玻色子和非齐次朝永-卢廷格液体，区分振子和中性可观测量的传递与带电场代数的传递。在单电荷模型中，前两个概念是一致的。全局传输还需要重新调整紧凑零模式的相位。对于规则的反射对称通道，精确的振荡器传递迫使光交叉时间为奇数倍，并且严格排序、奇偶校验兼容的光谱仅在有限的多个级别上不同于共形梯。当包括由物理剖面引起的 Robin 边界数据时，该光谱条件也足够了。
